pieces.name: tree_seed42
pieces.style: full voxel relief canopy overhanging a slim trunk — every block steps in or out so the scene reads as a 3D block sculpture from the front and the back, with a smooth rounded core hidden between the two faces
pieces.use_suggestion: Sits on a desk or clamps to the edge with the matching clamp. The headband drops into the channel and rests on the smooth crest, so the ear cups hang clear either side of the trunk and the blocky scene stays unbroken front and back. Each seed grows a different canopy.
pieces.print_note: Print lying on the back face — every overhang in the silhouette becomes flat geometry that way.

pieces.name: desk_clamp
pieces.style: C-clamp with a dovetail rail — any stand in this set slides straight down onto it
pieces.use_suggestion: Hooks over a desk edge and tightens with the printed thumbscrew, then the stand slides down onto the dovetail rail. The stands also work free-standing without it.
pieces.print_note: Print with the C-opening facing up (spine flat on the bed) so both jaws rise vertically.

pieces.name: clamp_thumbscrew
pieces.style: knurled knob with a printed 6mm-pitch thread
pieces.use_suggestion: Threads into the desk clamp to grip the table. No nuts or bolts required.
pieces.print_note: Print knob-down on the bed, threads pointing up.

collection_note: Original blocky voxel art — an independent design, not affiliated with or endorsed by any game.
material_note: PLA prints fine; PETG or ABS is tougher for the clamp and thumbscrew.
